column3: NKJV has “God is my strength and power, and He makes my way perfect”; the Hebrew reads “God is my strong refuge, and he sets free the blameless one, my way,” and the meaning is uncertain.
NKJV renders וַעֲנֹתְךָ (“your answering” or “your humility”) as “Your gentleness.”
NKJV renders “they gird themselves” as “come frightened.”
